palette: warm backlit parchment screen, amber lamp glow, ochre umber vignette, deep ink silhouettes, cinnabar seal accents, indigo and bamboo counterpoints
typography: WenKai show plaques on ink silhouette panels, warm light body text inside cut-out cards, ink annotations directly on the lit screen
composition: backlit gauze stage with hanging puppet plaques, twin comparison lanes, figure-group vignettes, descending and ascending flow columns, and a closing ledger couplet
surface: translucent warm gauze with lamp halo and soft stage frame; knowledge cards read as jointed leather silhouettes with warm light interiors
motion: puppets and plaques enter the screen in legal order, property tokens travel to their ownership destination, seals stamp operative results, couplets land last
transition: screen-light rise between scenes with the lamp re-focusing on the next act
